tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gshed dmar gyi sgrub thabs blo dman dga' bskyed bzhugs// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ gshin rje gshed dmar po bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed mdor bsdus bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā wa'i sngags brjod de/ rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang am̐ las nyi ma la hūm̐ las gshin rje gshed dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin zhing / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan zhing / 'dzag pa'i mgo bo brgya phyed kyis do shal dang / skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ ma he dmar po'i steng na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ rang gi thugs kar sa bon kyis mthar bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang la gnyis su med par thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur/

ces brjod cing bsam la/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥwi ṭi tā na na hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ ya man+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces ci nus bzla/ bsnyen pa byed na sngags gnyis ka bzhi 'bum la sogs pa gang 'grub bya/ thun nas ldang bar 'dod pa na/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi skal ba bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /gshin rje gshed dpal 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces sogs kyi bsngo ba dang smon lam rnam par dag pa btab la spyod lam thams cad du lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten pa'i rang bzhin du gsal btab cing chos mthun gyi spyod pas dus 'da' zhing gnas par bya'o/ /de ltar gshin rje gshed dpal gyi/ /sgrub thabs 'di ni sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ /bris pas lha yis rjes 'dzin shog /ces sa sbrul zla ba bdun pa'i tshes lnga'i nyin bzhi thog bla brang gi tshoms dmar chen mo'i 7chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i bzhugs khri pad+ma can gyi drung du mgyogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gdong dga' pa gso rig mkhas pa bsam pa don chen gyis bgyis so/ /bkra shis/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ gshed dmar gyi sgrub thabs blo dman dga' bskyed/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
